CREATE TABLE "${ns}"."ns_permsPlan" ("_id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL, "_uid" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, "_createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NULL DEFAULT NULL, "_updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NULL DEFAULT NULL, "title" VARCHAR(64) NULL, "_permissions" JSONB NULL DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("_id")); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ns_permsPlan_uid" ON "${ns}"."ns_permsPlan" ("_uid" COLLATE utf8_ci_ai); CREATE INDEX "ns_permsPlan_created" ON "${ns}"."ns_permsPlan" ("_createdAt"); CREATE INDEX "ns_permsPlan_updated" ON "${ns}"."ns_permsPlan" ("_updatedAt"); CREATE INDEX "ns_permsPlan_permissions" ON "${ns}"."ns_permsPlan" USING GIN ("_permissions")

CREATE TABLE "${ns}"."ns_permsPlan_perms" ("_id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL, "_tenant" INTEGER NULL DEFAULT NULL, "_type" VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, "_permission" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, "_document" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("_id")); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ns_permsPlan_ukey" ON "${ns}"."ns_permsPlan_perms" USING BTREE ("_document" COLLATE utf8_ci_ai, "_type", "_permission"); CREATE INDEX "ns_permsPlan_permission" ON "${ns}"."ns_permsPlan_perms" USING BTREE ("_permission", "_type")

CREATE TABLE "${ns}"."ns_vectorPlan" ("_id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL, "_uid" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, "_createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NULL DEFAULT NULL, "_updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NULL DEFAULT NULL, "embedding" VECTOR(3) NULL, "_permissions" JSONB NULL DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("_id")); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ns_vectorPlan_uid" ON "${ns}"."ns_vectorPlan" ("_uid" COLLATE utf8_ci_ai); CREATE INDEX "ns_vectorPlan_created" ON "${ns}"."ns_vectorPlan" ("_createdAt"); CREATE INDEX "ns_vectorPlan_updated" ON "${ns}"."ns_vectorPlan" ("_updatedAt"); CREATE INDEX "ns_vectorPlan_permissions" ON "${ns}"."ns_vectorPlan" USING GIN ("_permissions")

CREATE TABLE "${ns}"."ns_vectorPlan_perms" ("_id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL, "_tenant" INTEGER NULL DEFAULT NULL, "_type" VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, "_permission" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, "_document" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("_id")); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ns_vectorPlan_ukey" ON "${ns}"."ns_vectorPlan_perms" USING BTREE ("_document" COLLATE utf8_ci_ai, "_type", "_permission"); CREATE INDEX "ns_vectorPlan_permission" ON "${ns}"."ns_vectorPlan_perms" USING BTREE ("_permission", "_type")

SELECT *, ("table_main"."embedding" <=> ?::vector)::text AS "_distance" FROM "${ns}"."ns_vectorPlan" AS "table_main" WHERE "table_main"."embedding" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ("table_main"."embedding" <=> ?::vector) LIMIT ?
